excerpt: Have Martin read, create, and update events in your calendar.
Have Martin read, draft, and reply to emails in your inbox.
Have Martin read and send messages in Slack from your account.
Tell Martin to remind you to do something, and he will ping you when the time comes.
You can tell Martin to add, edit, and check off your to-dos on your behalf from any interface.
You can tell Martin to read, add, and edit your notes from any interface.
Create custom shortcuts that trigger multi-step actions.
Martin syncs with multiple search engines to find you the most relevant information.
Martin can send you daily or weekly briefings via email.
Martin can proactively draft emails for you and send them on your behalf.
Martin can automatically label your emails and take follow up actions on your behalf.
Martin can call you at a specific time every morning to wake you up with the weather and your schedule.
Cc Martin on an email to schedule a meeting.
Send or forward emails to Martin

Once connected, you can tell Martin to add an event to your calendar, and he will add it at the specified time with the specified details.
Once connected, you can tell Martin to read, draft, and reply to emails on your behalf.
Once connected, you can tell Martin to read, send, and reply to Slack messages on your behalf.
Tell Martin to remind you to do something, and he will ping you at the specified time, via the specified interface.
Call Martin and say "Note down everything we talked about on this call and call it 'Brain Dump'."
Got an email with events coming up? Forward it to Martin, and he'll add them all to your calendar.
Martin is reachable through all your communication channels, including phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and Slack.
Optionally, you can import your to-dos from Todoist in the Martin web app -> Settings -> To-dos.
Separately, Martin can send and react to messages from your own Slack account on command.
I’m impressed. I’ll probably cancel ChatGPT Pro subscription and switch to this... it’s handling some complicated requests correctly the first time... It got it right the first time. Pretty amazing.

I want this, but very concerned about the security and privacy - you're talking about getting my most personal of personals (email, calendar, messages, phone calls). This could be a nightmare of privacy or security breaches.

You should create a system where you cannot access user data, and it can never be shared with third parties. Make that system open source to prove it... Otherwise, I’ll never feel confident telling Martin anything I don’t want advertisers to know.

oh, martin desktop is finally here! I use Martin to manage my todo list while i'm coding (on an hourly basis) - having it aside VSC is so handy! ... It's very nice to have a cloud-based agent that can access my todo whichever device/app i'm on.
I would try this if it had Android support! Is that planned?

A big piece of product feedback we got was 'I don't trust AI to take actions like sending texts/emails on my behalf if it's not 100% reliable.' We're happy to report that Martin's failure rate is now a lot lower than before.
